subject: Re: Pilot pricing + invoice snapshot for OptimizeAI integration
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Raines <tom.r@optimizeai.com>, Kate Lin <kate@optimizeai.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T15:18:00-08:00
Subject: Pilot pricing + invoice snapshot for OptimizeAI integration

Tom/Kate — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and the pricing assumptions we used for the attached token workbook (optimizeai_token_breakdown.xlsx). Please review and confirm the numbers below so we can finalize a pilot invoice.

Summary of what you shared:
- Expected steady-state usage: 150–250M tokens/month (50M token bursts on high-traffic days)
- Primary workload: multi-turn chat + short summarization (~80% gen, 20% embeddings for retrieval)
- Latency SLO target: 200–400ms p50 for gen requests
- Security: data residency US; SOC2 in scope (we'll include compliance addendum)

Pricing assumptions we used (attached):
- Model: rw-large-v2 equivalent pricing profile (open model variant)
- Unit reference: pricing presented as $ per 1M tokens
- Baseline target you mentioned: ~$1,000 per 1M tokens (budget ceiling)
- Net blended unit we modeled: $920 per 1M tokens based on continuous batching + 8% discount for pilot reserved baseline

Pilot invoice snapshot (what I propose):
- Pilot term: 30 days, up to 200M included tokens (monthly baseline)
- Overages: billed at $1,080 per 1M tokens (peak/ondemand rate)
- One-time onboarding fee: $4,000 (integration + Q/A + SOC2 evidence handoff)
- Estimated pilot invoice: $4,000 onboarding + $184,000 usage = $188,000 (this is conservative, see invoice_snapshot_v1.pdf attached with line items)

Next steps / asks: 
1) Confirm that 200M included tokens aligns with your procurement/budget expectations. If your preferred baseline is 150M, we can recalculate and drop the per-1M rate to ~$980.
2) Let us know the procurement timeline and whether you need a pro forma invoice or PO details.
3) If you want a smaller test, we can do a 30-day 50M pilot at a higher per-1M to lower the upfront cost — tell us which you prefer.

Attachments: optimizeai_token_breakdown.xlsx (token mix & request distribution). I'll follow up with an invoice PDF and the pricing calculator after you confirm the baseline.

Thanks —
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Tom Raines <tom.r@optimizeai.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Kate Lin <kate@optimizeai.ai>
Date: 2026-11-20T17:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing + invoice snapshot for OptimizeAI integration

Michael — thanks for the recap and the breakdown. A couple quick clarifications before we push to procurement: 

1) The team expects ~180M steady with spikes to 300M this quarter (marketing campaign). Will overage protection or soft caps be possible? If we hit burst, we want predictable throttling vs surprise invoices.
2) The $188k pilot number is above our initial headcount-approved budget. Our CFO prefers staying under $140k for POC spending. Can you do a revised scenario: 150M baseline + 30 day trial with a prepay credit and tightened overage cap?
3) Timeline: procurement wants a pro forma and line item invoice this week if possible.

Also please confirm the SLA and whether we can get a 24/7 escalations contact during the pilot. Kate is on this thread and will coordinate procurement.

On Tue, Nov 20, 2026 at 3:18 PM Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Tom/Kate — great to meet earlier. Quick recap from our discovery call and the pricing assumptions we used for the attached token workbook (optimizeai_token_breakdown.xlsx). Please review and confirm the numbers below so we can finalize a pilot invoice.

Thanks,
Tom

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Raines <tom.r@optimizeai.com>, Kate Lin <kate@optimizeai.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-21T09:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Pilot pricing + invoice snapshot for OptimizeAI integration

Tom — understood and appreciate the budget constraint. I updated the workbook and attached a formal invoice snapshot (invoice_snapshot_v1.pdf) plus the pricing calculator (redwood_pricing_calculator.csv). Two alternative proposals to meet your CFO target: 

Option A — Lower baseline, prepay credit (recommended if procurement needs lower up-front):
- Baseline: 150M included tokens for 30 days
- Prepay credit: $120,000 applied to usage (reduces near-term cash impact)
- Unit modeled after prepay: $960 per 1M tokens effective
- Overages capped: automatic throttling at +50% of baseline unless you opt-in to pay overage at $1,100 per 1M
- Estimated invoice: $4,000 onboarding + $120,000 prepay = $124,000 (falls under your $140k cap)

Option B — Full baseline but staged payments (recommended to keep coverage for spikes):
- Baseline: 200M included tokens
- Billing: 50% upfront ($94k), 50% at day 15 reconciliation
- Effective blended unit: $920 per 1M
- Estimated invoice first installment: $98,000 onboarding + first installment = $102,000 (followed by reconciliation)

SLA / escalation: we can provide a 24/7 pilot escalation contact and an SLA addendum for the 30-day pilot. I'll loop in operations if you confirm Option A or B.

Attachments: invoice_snapshot_v1.pdf (line-item pilot invoice), redwood_pricing_calculator.csv (editable calculator with toggles for baseline, prepay, and overage caps).

Can you confirm which option procurement prefers and whether they need us to route the pro forma to a specific vendor contact? If Option A works, we can issue the PO-ready invoice by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Michael Grant
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:42:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: OptimizeAI — finalize pilot price path / docs to send

Michael / Sergio — internal note after Tom's ask:
- They want a path under $140k. Option A (150M prepay $120k + $4k onboarding) looks best to close quickly. We should tighten overage behavior to a hard throttle at +25% for the pilot (doc this as a temporary pilot protection). Include explicit line item: "pilot throttle protection (no charge above 25% spike unless customer opts in)".
- Update invoice_snapshot_v1.pdf to show two pro forma variants: (1) prepay 150M at $120k; (2) staged 200M with first installment. Label the PDF pages clearly for procurement.
- Action items: Sergio to generate revised invoice PDF with the throttle line and PO-ready vendor info. Michael to attach the pro forma and send to Tom/Kate with a one-click acceptance link (DocuSign or purchase order instructions).

Attachments referenced: optimizeai_token_breakdown.xlsx, redwood_pricing_calculator.csv (already in thread).

Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
